zechariah.6.p1.b1.text: And again I lifted up my eyes and saw four chariots coming out from between two mountains—mountains of bronze.

zechariah.6.p1.b2.text: The first chariot had red horses, the second black horses, the third white horses, and the fourth dappled horses—all of them strong.

zechariah.6.p1.b4.text: These are the four spirits of heaven, going forth from their station before the Lord of all the earth.

zechariah.6.p1.b6.text: Behold, those going to the land of the north have given rest to My Spirit in the land of the north.

zechariah.6.p2.b1.text: Take an offering from the exiles—from Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah

zechariah.6.p2.b2.text: Take silver and gold, make an ornate crown, and set it on the head of the high priest, Joshua son of Jehozadak.

zechariah.6.p2.b3.text: Here is a man whose name is the Branch, and He will branch out from His place and build the temple of the LORD.

zechariah.6.p2.b4.text: … will sit on His throne and rule. And He will be a priest on His throne, and there will be peaceful counsel between the two.

zechariah.6.p2.b5.text: Even those far away will come and build the temple of the LORD, and you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me to you.
